title: An LLM’s Attempts to Adapt to Diverse Software Engineers’ Problem-Solving Styles: More Inclusive & Equitable?

bias_targets.methodology: Conducted a user study with 53 software engineers to evaluate LLM-generated code explanations that were either unadapted, matched, or mismatched to their specific problem-solving styles (Learning Style, Self-Efficacy, Attitudes Toward Risk, Information Processing Style, and Motivations). The study measured equity and inclusivity by comparing survey ratings (Feelings, Trust, Cognitive Load, and Utility) between groups with opposing problem-solving style values.
